answer: Quartz-based reputation tokens anchor each AI agent's digital identity to provable computational work. Onyx verification nodes cross-check agent behavior patterns, ensuring consistent interaction histories. Wander detection algorithms monitor anomalous identity hopping, flagging suspicious agents before they can accumulate voting power. When fake identities emerge, quartz tokens become expensive to clone while onyx nodes efficiently isolate wanderers. The system's Sybil resistance grows exponentially with network size, making attacks economically prohibitive.
